representation_property_to_measure: Same-label neighbourhood agreement and cluster separation
direct_downstream_endpoint: Resolution-grid ARI NMI and per-label F1
minimum_sensitivity_check: Embedding seeds and graph neighbourhood size
condition_requiring_restriction: Annotation agreement is weak or expected marker programs are absent

direct_downstream_endpoint: Per-label precision recall and F1 across the resolution grid
minimum_sensitivity_check: Embedding seeds graph settings and cell subsampling
condition_requiring_restriction: Recovery occurs only at one resolution or without marker support

direct_downstream_endpoint: Agreement of representation-derived pseudotime and branch assignments
independent_consistency_reference: Lineage-marker monotonicity and published lineage annotations
minimum_sensitivity_check: Root definition output dimension and embedding seed
condition_requiring_restriction: Ordering or branch assignment changes materially with root or dimension

direct_downstream_endpoint: Stability of coarse cluster or trajectory relations
independent_consistency_reference: Known anatomical developmental or experimental ordering where available
condition_requiring_restriction: Only the displayed two-dimensional layout supports the relation

representation_property_to_measure: Cell-type retention separated from donor-associated information
direct_downstream_endpoint: Held-donor-out cell-type prediction and donor predictability
minimum_sensitivity_check: Donor-level estimates embedding seed and graph setting
condition_requiring_restriction: Cell-type performance does not generalise to held-out donors or donor signal dominates the representation
